statements.subject: server
statements.description: When an agent supports multiple protocols, all supported protocols MUST: Provide the same set of operations and capabilities; Return semantically equivalent results for the same requests; Map errors consistently using appropriate protocol-specific codes; Support the same authentication schemes declared in the AgentCard
statements.post_cond: agent.protocols.functionality = equivalent & agent.protocols.behavior = equivalent & agent.protocols.error_handling = consistent & agent.protocols.authentication_schemes = equivalent
actions: Provide the same set of operations and capabilities across all supported protocols
Return semantically equivalent results for the same requests across all supported protocols
Map errors consistently using appropriate protocol-specific codes across all supported protocols
Support the same authentication schemes declared in the AgentCard across all supported protocols
